Name: Milk Bottles and Cans
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Hey guys, this is just a simple graphics replacement for your milks. Hope you enjoy.[/i]

[b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the graphics of small milk, large milk, small goats milk, and large goats milk.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6522/6522-1595893119-799144599.png[/img]
[i]As of 1.6 update this also includes an Iridium Milk can!

[/i][b]You May Also Enjoy:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24163/]More Bottles and Cans
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25335]Milkable Sheep[/url] by radmaninoff - with matching Sheep Milk Bottle & Can
[size=2][i]
[/i][/size][b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Downloads.Description: Replaces milk graphics. Requires Content Patcher. Updated for 1.6 (no changes required), and changed archive filetype to zip.
